import_story.title: SO-UI-Rework Live
import_story.description: A public UI and model-routing fixture.

checkpoints.name: An open gate
checkpoints.objective: Describe an open gate and let the player decide where to go.

steps.eval: const rt=globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s=rt.getSnapshot(); if (!s.features.inner.enabled || !s.features.inner.controls.harvestReasoning.value) throw new Error('inner voice must remain on'); if (s.features.pacing.enabled || !s.features.pacing.declined) throw new Error('story decline was not resolved'); if (!rt.setFeatureOverride('pacing',{enabled:true})) throw new Error('chat override refused'); if (!rt.getSnapshot().features.pacing.reenabled) throw new Error('re-enable warning absent'); if (rt.getStory().features.pacing !== 'off') throw new Error('chat preference changed authored policy'); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter(k=>k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; return {inner:true,storyDecline:true,chatReenabled:true};

const rt=globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if(!rt.setFeatureOverride('thinking',{effort:'low'})) throw new Error('thinking override refused'); if(rt.getSnapshot().features.thinking.controls.effort.source!=='chat') throw new Error('thinking source is not chat'); return {thinkingOverride:true};

send_generate.text: I pause at the open gate and look for a sign showing where the road leads. What can I see?

steps.eval: const shots=globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.reasoningEffect?.shots()??[]; if(!shots.some(s=>s.source==='chat'&&s.level==='low'&&s.budget===128&&s.set.length)) throw new Error('chat thinking budget did not reach a real generation'); return {thinkingBudget:128,source:'chat',shots:shots.length};

const rt=globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s=rt.getSnapshot(); const audits=s.extraction.audits; if (!audits.length) throw new Error('real read produced no audit'); if (!audits.some(a=>typeof a.rawResponse==='string'&&a.rawResponse.trim())) throw new Error('no real read response'); if(s.boundary<1) throw new Error('no rendered reply boundary'); const c=SillyTavern.getContext(); const replies=c.chat.filter(m=>!m.is_user&&!m.is_system&&String(m.mes??'').trim()); if(!replies.length) throw new Error('no visible reply'); return {boundary:s.boundary,audits:audits.length,replies:replies.length,innerEnabled:s.features.inner.enabled,chatOverride:s.features.pacing.source};
const modal=document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]'); if(!modal) throw new Error('workspace failed to open after real generation'); return {workspace:true};
